python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
anchor = fluentqt.Button("Reset toolbar", %PARENT%)
anchor.setFixedSize(136, 32)
anchor.move(162, 174)
anchor.show()
control = fluentqt.Flyout(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setAnchor(anchor)
control.setLightDismissConsumesPress(True)
layout = QVBoxLayout(control)
layout.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 18)
layout.setSpacing(6)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Reset layout?", control)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
layout.addWidget(heading)
body = fluentqt.Label("Restore toolbar items to defaults.", control)
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(body)
action = fluentqt.Button("Reset now", control)
action.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
layout.addWidget(action, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
control.setMinimumSize(256, 104)
action.clicked.connect(control.close)
anchor.clicked.connect(control.open)
